text: Takhliq-e-Insan: Allah Ta'ala aasmanon ki aur unke roshan sitaron ki qasam khata hai. Tariq ki tafsir chamakte sitare se ki hai, wajah yeh hai ke din ko chhupe rehte hain aur raat ko zahir ho jate hain. Ek sahih hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mana farmaya ke koi apne ghar raat ke waqt be-khabar aa jaye, yahan bhi lafz taroq hai, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ek dua mein bhi Tariq ka lafz aaya hai. Saqib kehte hain chamkile aur roshni wale ko jo shaitan par girta hai aur use jala deta hai. Har shakhs par Allah ki taraf se ek muhafiz muqarrar hai jo use aafaat se bachata hai, jaise aur jagah hai ke aayat (Lahu mu'aqqibatun mim-baini yadayhi wa min khalfihi yahfazunahu min amrillahi innallaha la yughayyiru ma bi-qawmin hatta yughayyiru ma bi-anfusihim wa iza aradallahu bi-qawmin su'an fala maradda lahu wa ma lahum min dunihi miw-walin) (13. Ar-Ra'd: 11) yani aage peeche se bari-bari aane wale farishte muqarrar hain jo Allah ke hukm se bande ki hifazat karte hain. Insan ki za'eefi ka bayan ho raha hai ke dekho to iski asal kya hai aur goya is mein nihayat bariki ke sath Qayamat ka yaqeen dilaya gaya hai ke jo ibtidai paidaish par qadir hai woh lautane par qadir kyun na hoga, jaise farmaya aayat (Wa huwallazi yabda'ul-khalqa summa yu'iduhu wa huwa ahwanu 'alaihi) (30. Ar-Rum: 27) yani jisne pehle paida kiya woh hi dobara lautayega aur yeh is par bahut hi aasan hai. Insan uchalne wale pani yani aurat mard ki mani se paida kiya gaya hai jo mard ki peeth se aur aurat ki chhati se nikalti hai. Aurat ka yeh pani zard rang ka aur patla hota hai aur dono se bachche ki paidaish hoti hai. Tara'ib kehte hain haar ki jagah ko, kandhon se lekar seene tak ko bhi kaha gaya hai aur narkhare se neeche ko bhi kaha gaya hai aur chhatiyon se upar ke hisse ko bhi kaha gaya hai aur neeche ki taraf char pasliyon ko bhi kaha gaya hai aur dono chhatiyon aur dono pairon aur dono aankhon ke darmiyan ko bhi kaha gaya hai, dil ke nichod ko bhi kaha gaya hai, seena aur peeth ke darmiyan ko bhi kaha jata hai. Woh iske lautane par qadir hai yani nikle hue pani ko uski jagah wapas pahuncha dene par aur yeh matlab ke use dobara paida karke Aakhirat ki taraf lautane par bhi pichla qaul hi achha hai aur yeh daleel kayi martaba bayan ho chuki hai. Phir farmaya ke Qayamat ke din poshidgiyan khul jayengi, raaz zahir ho jayenge, bhed aashkar ho jayenge. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain har ghaddar ki ranon ke darmiyan uske ghaddar ka jhanda gaar diya jayega aur elaan ho jayega ke yeh fulan bin fulan ki ghaddari hai. Us din na to khud insan ko koi quwwat hasil hogi na uska madadgar koi aur khada hoga, yani na to khud apne aap ko azabon se bacha sakega na koi aur hoga jo use Allah ke azab se bacha sake.

Ek sahih hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mana farmaya ke koi apne ghar raat ke waqt be-khabar aa jaye, yahan bhi lafz taroq hai, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ek dua mein bhi Tariq ka lafz aaya hai. Saqib kehte hain chamkile aur roshni wale ko jo shaitan par girta hai aur use jala deta hai. Har shakhs par Allah ki taraf se ek muhafiz muqarrar hai jo use aafaat se bachata hai, jaise aur jagah hai ke aayat (Lahu mu'aqqibatun mim-baini yadayhi wa min khalfihi yahfazunahu min amrillahi innallaha la yughayyiru ma bi-qawmin hatta yughayyiru ma bi-anfusihim wa iza aradallahu bi-qawmin su'an fala maradda lahu wa ma lahum min dunihi miw-walin) (13. Ar-Ra'd: 11) yani aage peeche se bari-bari aane wale farishte muqarrar hain jo Allah ke hukm se bande ki hifazat karte hain. Insan ki za'eefi ka bayan ho raha hai ke dekho to iski asal kya hai aur goya is mein nihayat bariki ke sath Qayamat ka yaqeen dilaya gaya hai ke jo ibtidai paidaish par qadir hai woh lautane par qadir kyun na hoga, jaise farmaya aayat (Wa huwallazi yabda'ul-khalqa summa yu'iduhu wa huwa ahwanu 'alaihi) (30. Ar-Rum: 27) yani jisne pehle paida kiya woh hi dobara lautayega aur yeh is par bahut hi aasan hai. Insan uchalne wale pani yani aurat mard ki mani se paida kiya gaya hai jo mard ki peeth se aur aurat ki chhati se nikalti hai. Aurat ka yeh pani zard rang ka aur patla hota hai aur dono se bachche ki paidaish hoti hai. Tara'ib kehte hain haar ki jagah ko, kandhon se lekar seene tak ko bhi kaha gaya hai aur narkhare se neeche ko bhi kaha gaya hai aur chhatiyon se upar ke hisse ko bhi kaha gaya hai aur neeche ki taraf char pasliyon ko bhi kaha gaya hai aur dono chhatiyon aur dono pairon aur dono aankhon ke darmiyan ko bhi kaha gaya hai, dil ke nichod ko bhi kaha gaya hai, seena aur peeth ke darmiyan ko bhi kaha jata hai. Woh iske lautane par qadir hai yani nikle hue pani ko uski jagah wapas pahuncha dene par aur yeh matlab ke use dobara paida karke Aakhirat ki taraf lautane par bhi pichla qaul hi achha hai aur yeh daleel kayi martaba bayan ho chuki hai. Phir farmaya ke Qayamat ke din poshidgiyan khul jayengi, raaz zahir ho jayenge, bhed aashkar ho jayenge. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain har ghaddar ki ranon ke darmiyan uske ghaddar ka jhanda gaar diya jayega aur elaan ho jayega ke yeh fulan bin fulan ki ghaddari hai. Us din na to khud insan ko koi quwwat hasil hogi na uska madadgar koi aur khada hoga, yani na to khud apne aap ko azabon se bacha sakega na koi aur hoga jo use Allah ke azab se bacha sake.

Sadaqat-e-Quran ka zikr. Raj' ke ma'ani barish, barish wale badal, barasne, har saal bandon ki rozi lautane jis ke baghair insaan aur un ke janwar halak ho jayen, suraj chand aur sitaron ke idhar udhar lautne ke marwi hain. Zameen phatti hai to dane, ghaas aur chara nikalta hai. Yeh Quran haq hai, adl ka mazhar hai, yeh koi uzr, qissa baatein nahin. Kafir ise jhutlate hain, Allah ki raah se logon ko rokte hain, tarah tarah ke makr-o-fareb se logon ko Quran ke khilaf uksate hain. Ae Nabi (ﷺ)! Tu inhein zara si dheel de, phir anqareeb dekh lega ke kaise kaise badtareen azabon mein pakde jate hain. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Numatti'uhum qaleelan thumma nadtarruhum ila azabin ghaleez) (31. Luqman: 24) yani hum inhein kuch yunhi sa faida denge phir nihayat sakht azab ki taraf inhein bebas kar denge. Alhamdulillah, Surah Tariq ki tafsir khatam hui.
